chunks: Yahya ibn Aktham, the judge, asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام:
about the salat of Fajr: why is the recitation done aloud in it, even though it is among the daytime prayers, while recitation aloud is only in the night prayer?
So he said: “Because the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform it in the darkness at dawn, so he made it close to the night.”

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يُغَلِّسُ: to perform in the darkness of early dawn

ai.seo_question: Why is the recitation in salat al-Fajr aloud even though it is a daytime prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith explains why the salat of Fajr is recited aloud despite belonging to the daytime prayers. Imam عليه السلام states that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform it at the dark break of dawn, so it was treated as close to the night prayer in this respect.
